translation: Twenty-two: From the beginning to now there has been no pain or itching. One day while rubbing, the two flanks and two arms itched strangely like tinea, and I absolutely did not dare scratch; I rubbed each place separately, and in two or three days it spread to Danzhong and Quepen and healed; I think the accumulation of the two places had dispersed upward. Then various places began to have itching, of varying up and down, large and small, long and short; rubbing it, it healed at once.
